kurals.pope: So learn that you may full and faultless learning gain, Then in obedience meet to lessons learnt remain
kurals.meaning: Learn what is worth learning, and learn it well. Then let your life stand by it.
Trouble as wide as a flood fades once a clear mind turns and looks at it.
The company of good people is like a good book: every return gives you more.
Forgetting a kindness is never good. Letting go of a wrong the same day is.
The earth carries even those who dig into it. Bearing those who scorn us is the highest strength.
A mind kept clean is the whole of virtue. The rest is only noise.
Even when fate refuses the result, effort still pays the wage of its labour.
Whoever says a thing, wisdom is seeing the truth inside it.
Let them come, even for one day, and every ache would ease.
